question: calculate 2023 ANC coverage rate minus 2021 rate in percentage points for Gaya and Nalanda
gold_sql: WITH rates AS (SELECT district, year, 100.0 * anc4_completed / pregnancies_registered AS rate FROM anc_visits WHERE district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda') AND year IN (2021, 2023)) SELECT district, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN rate END) - MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2021 THEN rate END), 1) AS change_pp FROM rates GROUP BY district ORDER BY district
sql_duckdb: WITH rates AS (SELECT year, SUM(anc4_completed) AS completed, SUM(pregnancies_registered) AS registered FROM anc_visits WHERE district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda') AND year IN (2021, 2023) GROUP BY year) SELECT (CAST(r2023.completed AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(NULLIF(r2023.registered, 0), 0) * 100) - (CAST(r2021.completed AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(NULLIF(r2021.registered, 0), 0) * 100) AS coverage_change_pct_points FROM rates AS r2023 JOIN rates AS r2021 ON r2023.year = 2023 AND r2021.year = 2021

CURRENT QUESTION:
calculate 2023 ANC coverage rate minus 2021 rate in percentage points for Gaya and Nalanda
attempts.response:
WITH rates AS (
  SELECT
    year,
    SUM(anc4_completed) AS completed,
    SUM(pregnancies_registered) AS registered
  FROM anc_visits
  WHERE district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda')
    AND year IN (2021, 2023)
  GROUP BY year
)
SELECT
  (CAST(r2023.completed AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(r2023.registered, 0) * 100) -
  (CAST(r2021.completed AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(r2021.registered, 0) * 100) AS coverage_change_pct_points
FROM rates r2023
JOIN rates r2021 ON r2023.year = 2023 AND r2021.year = 2021;
